title: Provisional Quantification of Candidates – Lecturer Positions (Advertisement No. 62 (2025))
text:
📢 Official Notification

Lecturer Positions (English & Pharmacy)

In pursuance of
Advertisement No. 62 (2025)
dated

September 6, 2025
,
and the screening test conducted by the Educational Testing and Evaluation Agency (ETEA) on

April 5, 2026
,
the provisional quantification of qualifying candidates for the positions of
Lecturer in English and Pharmacy
has been uploaded on the online portal.

Applicants are advised to check their status by logging into the portal using the same credentials provided at the time of application:

🔗 Access Online Portal (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/posts/lecturer-posts)

⚠️ Important Deadline

In case of any grievance, an appeal may be submitted within one week by logging into the online portal using the same credentials used at the time of application

Last Date:

May 11, 2026 (till 05:00 PM)

Appeals submitted through any other means or after the deadline shall
not be entertained
.
